validity.researcher_notes: PARENT-ATTRIBUTION concern, not a spec concern (orchestrator re-read 2026-09-14). The row's SegmentName is already 'Blackfin Pipeline' and every recorded spec describes Blackfin correctly; what is contested is the PipelineName, which files Blackfin as a segment of Matterhorn Express. EIA's Aug 2026 release carries the two as separate projects with different sponsors' specs — Blackfin at 193 mi / 36,48 in / 3500 MMcf/d, status Construction (Aug 2026 sheet row 16) and Matterhorn Express at 687 mi / 42 in / 2500 MMcf/d, Completed (Historical Projects sheet row 1116) — and the row's own Owner cell reads 'Blackfin Pipeline LLC [100.%]', a separate entity from the Matterhorn Express JV. Both are WhiteWater Midstream projects, which is the likely source of the conflation. Second-source support is thin: pboilandgasmagazine.com titles its coverage 'Blackfin pipeline by WhiteWater Midstream' and treats it as its own line, but the other hit (oilgasleads.com, '185 Mile Blackfin Pipeline') is a leads aggregator and is not counted. Tier medium pending an operator statement or a FERC/RRC filing that names Blackfin's sponsor entity. NOT a duplicate of any other GEM row — no Blackfin row exists.
